review_method: Visual inspection of full PNG and decoded 512 px JPEG, plus independent pixel comparison to ancestor.
observations: Seated Pepe retains heavy-lidded eyes and wide mouth.
Both original visible hands counted: four fingers and one thumb each, five digits per hand. No new hands or stencils.
Two small charcoal pebbles and their ochre thread sit above Pepe on previously bare stone.
All inherited marks remain in position; rock, cracks, roots, warm light and framing preserved.
No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, frames, real people or political symbols observed.
limits: Visual review is a local observation, not independent artistic certification.
Generated motif is small and intentionally worn; the JPEG reduces fine pigment detail.
